title: bug: get_pending_questions (and wait_for_task's pending-question path) treat any non-"human" comment as an agent answer, so a moe-daemon system comment posted after a human question masks the still-unanswered question
description:
Held item from hunt #11 (task-afe61cc0, architect-74d9e1c7, msg-7ed73235), filed by the governor in BACKLOG. There is no live case today. Its fix may touch tools/waitForTask.ts, which task-4fbd3c69 is editing, so it waits on that row. The governor promotes it once 4fbd3c69 is DONE.

PROBLEM. get_pending_questions finds the last comment whose author is not 'human' and treats every human comment after it as unanswered. A comment the daemon posts itself, with author 'moe-daemon' (landing notes, system notices), is therefore taken as an agent's answer. A human question followed only by a daemon comment drops out of get_pending_questions and out of wait_for_task's pending-question surfacing, though nobody answered it.

EVIDENCE (at 8ca8d389):
- getPendingQuestions.ts:130 `if (comments[i].author !== 'human') {` (the "last agent comment" scan), then :136-139 `.filter((c) => c.author === 'human')` after it.
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-afe61cc0/B/zzHuntB_pendingMasked.test.ts with its .output.txt. "still surfaces the human question when only a moe-daemon comment follows it" fails, "Tests 1 failed (1)".

FIX DIRECTION.
- Skip system authors (moe-daemon, and any other daemon-authored id) when looking for the last answering comment.
- Apply the same rule wherever wait_for_task or taskPayload derive pending questions, so the two surfaces agree.
definitionOfDone: A human question followed only by moe-daemon comments still appears in get_pending_questions and in wait_for_task's pending-question surfacing. A human question followed by a real agent comment is still treated as answered.
The ported hunt repro passes, and the existing get_pending_questions and wait_for_task test files stay green in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
Add the one shared helper to packages/moe-daemon/src/util/taskPayload.ts, right after MAX_PENDING_QUESTIONS_PER_TASK. That is where the pending-question constants already live, and TaskComment is already imported there. Edit with the Edit tool only. The architect's dry-run diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-c8618ccd/taskPayload.diff.

- `const SYSTEM_COMMENT_AUTHORS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['moe-daemon']);` with a 2-line comment naming the two daemon writers: finalizeAttempt.ts:161 (landing notes) and delivery/repairActivation.ts:75 (diagnostics). These are the only daemon-authored comment ids in src; the architect grepped `author:` across non-test sources.
- `export function unansweredHumanComments(comments: readonly TaskComment[] | undefined): TaskComment[]`, with a doc comment:
  - `list = Array.isArray(comments) ? comments : []`;
  - scan from the end for the last comment whose author is neither 'human' nor in SYSTEM_COMMENT_AUTHORS (lastAnswer, -1 if none);
  - return `list.slice(lastAnswer + 1).filter((c) => c.author === 'human')`.

Error handling:
- A hand-edited non-array `comments` yields [] instead of throwing. That is backward-compatible with existing .moe/ files: today `task.comments || []` would throw on a truthy non-array.
- A comment without an author still counts as an answer, as today.
- No throw is added.

GREEN: make both pending-question surfaces use the helper. Edit with the Edit tool only. The dry-run diffs are getPendingQuestions.diff and waitForTask.diff in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-c8618ccd/.

(a) packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getPendingQuestions.ts:
- Add unansweredHumanComments to the existing '../util/taskPayload.js' import list.
- Replace :125-140 (the `comments` local, the lastAgentIdx scan and the slice/filter) with `const questions = unansweredHumanComments(task.comments).map((c) => ({ commentId: c.id, content: c.content, timestamp: c.timestamp }));` and a 1-line comment.
- Everything after it (maxQuestionsPerTask, compactQuestion, the result shape) is unchanged.

(b) packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/waitForTask.ts, findPendingQuestion (:77-104) ONLY:
- Add `import { unansweredHumanComments } from '../util/taskPayload.js';` after the logger import.
- Replace :91-102 (the `comments` local, the scan and hasUnansweredHumanComment) with `if (unansweredHumanComments(task.comments).length === 0) continue;`.
- In the (2) comment above it, change "the last agent comment" to "the last answering comment (the same helper, which skips the daemon's own comments)".

Scope:
- Do not touch waitForTask.ts's event filter or the wake path near :435-480. Sibling task-b7203d89 (delete wake) edits that region; in worktree mode separate hunks merge cleanly.
- Do not touch the hasPendingQuestion flag writers (WebSocketServer.ts:972, addComment.ts:123) or the two daemon comment writers. The flag stays set when a daemon comment lands, which is why both surfaces now see the question.

Error handling: no new failure path. get_pending_questions' parameter validation and wait_for_task's refusals are unchanged.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: A comment the daemon writes itself (author 'moe-daemon': landing notes, repair diagnostics) is never treated as an answer to a human question. get_pending_questions and wait_for_task's pending-question surfacing both derive unanswered questions through one shared helper, util/taskPayload unansweredHumanComments. A question is unanswered when it is a 'human' comment after the last comment by any author other than 'human' or the daemon. A human question followed only by daemon comments therefore stays pending on both surfaces, and a real agent comment still answers it.

completionSummary:
get_pending_questions and wait_for_task now derive unanswered human questions through one shared helper, util/taskPayload unansweredHumanComments. A comment authored 'moe-daemon' (landing notes, repair diagnostics) is no longer taken as an answer, so a human question followed only by daemon comments stays pending on both surfaces.
